mentions.name: TaskTiley
mentions.description: TaskTiley is a web-based task manager focused on building good habits. It features a GitHub-style year-long contribution graph that visualizes completed tasks over the year.
mentions.problem: Task managers lacked a year-long view of what had been completed, similar to what GitHub provides for developers.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://www.tasktiley.com/ which is a task manager focused on building good habits.  I was missing a year-long view of what had been completed (similar to what GitHub does for developers) so implemented a contribution graph for tasks.
